content:
iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max are set to launch next month, and besides featuring a number of new functions, reports suggest there will also be three design changes. Here's what's expected based on rumours.

#1: Rear glass and aluminium colour unified

Among the various design changes on the iPhone 17 Pro, the colour was clearly very well received, and no one minded the full-width camera plateau.

However, one of the design decisions proved somewhat controversial: the two-tone effect created by the rear glass and aluminium.

Fortunately, Apple is reportedly planning to address this issue on the iPhone 18 Pro.

Weibo leaker Instant Digital wrote:

I'm one of those users who finds the two-tone effect quite unpleasant to look at, so I'm excited to see Apple change direction on the iPhone 18 Pro.

#2: Dynamic Island shrinks

Apple introduced the Dynamic Island on the iPhone 14 Pro four years ago. Since then, although there have been plenty of rumours about a new, smaller design, the Dynamic Island has remained unchanged.

However, next month's iPhone 18 Pro will finally feature a new Dynamic Island design.

Rumours suggest the new Dynamic Island will be approximately 35% smaller on the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max.

Reportedly, some of the Face ID components will be moved beneath the display, but not all of them. So Apple has not yet switched to a punch-hole design — at least not for now.

#3: New colour, with deep cherry as the signature shade

Apple did something surprising with the iPhone 17 Pro: it offered bold and fun colour options.

Among them, Cosmic Orange proved particularly popular, proving that Apple's shift away from the standard black, white and grey was the right decision.

Rumours suggest the company plans to continue offering interesting colours for the Pro models on the iPhone 18 Pro. At least three colours are expected for now:

  • Deep Cherry
  • Silver
  • Light Blue

As for whether Space Grey / Black will return this year, the reports are somewhat contradictory, but it could potentially be a fourth colour option.

The "Deep Cherry" colour has been described as a blend of wine red, coffee brown and deep purple. It is expected to be the signature colour in Apple's marketing.

What are your thoughts on Apple's rumoured iPhone 18 Pro design changes? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.
